text: Dental cleaning was fast and good. I am satisfied
The root canal treatment was terrible. If left untreated, it would rot, requiring a new dentist to remove the old one and do it again, resulting in double the expense and a very long time.
I had dentures made for my mother, but the service was terrible. They didn't fit at all. I wasted a lot of money. Even after adjustments, they still didn't fit. In the end, I went to another clinic.

author_name: ภัคภิณญา ทองเจิม
